race.description: Green Triangle Livestock & Real Estate Hcp (54)
race.comment: MELISSA KATE (7) was a dominant winner three back in testing conditions and has since followed it up with solid efforts. The rise in trip won't bother the old girl and she rates one of the main chances. SO GRAND (11) improved last time out to finish under a length away from the winner when she did her best work late at Naracoorte. Will be hoping for a strong tempo so she can launch late under her light weight. LAPILLI (5) has been well below her best in her two runs back but strips fitter and strikes an easier assignment. Drawn to get all the favours. STARGUST (2) is knocking on the door and is another that will be hoping the pace is genuine so he can rattle home late. BAD TO THE BONE (6) was a good winner fresh at Port Augusta but has since struggled. Gets in light with the 4kg claim and is one for the exotics.
